description: Prepare the LangChain library for version 0.3.18 release by updating all relevant configuration files and workflows. This involves updating version references, ensuring CI/CD pipelines are correctly configured for the new release, and managing dependency locks.
functional_requirements: Update the version number in the LangChain package configuration files to 0.3.18
Verify and update all GitHub Actions workflows to ensure they properly handle the 0.3.18 release process
Refresh dependency lock files to ensure they reflect the current state for the 0.3.18 release
